brands/mindhaven@2026-11-02.audience: Adults in the UK dealing with anxiety, loss, stress or self-doubt who want private counselling: online across the UK, or in person in Dalkeith near Edinburgh. Also Hungarian speakers living in the UK (sessions in English or Hungarian).
brands/mindhaven@2026-11-02.offer: Erika Martin, MNCPS Accredited psychotherapeutic counsellor, PSA Registered, Advanced Diploma in Psychotherapeutic Counselling (Chrysalis, 2018). Integrative person-centred, also psychodynamic, uses CBT techniques when they suit the client. Works with anxiety and worry, grief and loss, low mood, relationships, self-esteem, stress or burnout, addiction (including family members) and big life changes or illness. £60 per 50-minute session pay as you go, or £300 for 6 sessions paid in advance (saves £60). Bupa accepted. Free 20-minute initial call. Online by Microsoft Teams or phone across the UK, or in person in Dalkeith. In English or Hungarian. No fixed number of sessions.
brands/mindhaven@2026-11-02.cta: Message me for a free 20-minute initial call, I reply the same day. mindhaven.uk
brands/mindhaven@2026-11-02.voice: Calm, warm, plain and non-clinical. Speaks to 'you'. You lead the pace; the tone is accepting and non-judgemental. Short paragraphs that explain the difference between two things people mix up (stress vs burnout, worry vs anxiety) or gently correct a common myth about counselling (you don't need to be in crisis, it isn't just advice, it doesn't have to take years). Never alarmist, no hype, not 'premium' or boutique. Closes with a soft line about counselling as a calm, confidential space.
brands/mindhaven@2026-11-02.rules: ERIKA APPROVES EVERY POST BEFORE PUBLISHING. No testimonials, client stories or anything that could identify a client. Only claim the approaches and areas listed in the offer: do not present her as a specialist in somatic or nervous-system work, trauma specialist, or anything not listed. No diagnosis, cure or outcome promises ('counselling can't fix you' is her own framing: it is a space to make sense of things). Prices only as stated (£60, or £300 for 6 prepaid); never mention '7th session free'. Score 0 for tragedies, suicides, violence, disasters or crisis news; never use distress as a hook. If a topic touches self-harm or crisis, add 'If you are struggling right now, Samaritans are free on 116 123' instead of a sales CTA.
